## Change

Describe the correction, official evidence and effective dates.

## Checks

- [ ] I ran relevant tests and described unavailable checks.
- [ ] No private company records, credentials or privileged material are included.
- [ ] Third-party material has its actual permission and attribution identified.
- [ ] For original code/content, I expressly acknowledge the additional contribution
      grant quoted in `CONTRIBUTING.md`, including commercial sublicensing rights.

For source links or public facts only, say so. An unchecked box is not consent.
Original contributions require express acknowledgement before merge.
